final_candidates.decision_summary: Threonine-to-isoleucine near the HA1 C-terminal stem region replaces a polar residue with a hydrophobic one, analogous to known thermostability-enhancing substitutions in influenza HA. Verified WT T at position 318.
Alanine-to-isoleucine in the HA2 N-terminal/fusion-peptide-adjacent hydrophobic stretch (FGAIAGFIE) improves hydrophobic core packing. Verified WT A at position 334.
Glutamate-to-lysine in the HA2 stem helix region may introduce favorable charge-charge interactions and helix stabilization without perturbing the core. Verified WT E at position 410.

stop_reason.detail: Budget and round limit reached; final Top-3 selected by LLM-only reasoning with no external evidence.
